why: The S turns 45 degrees clockwise each step and also flips over every second step: S upright, flipped S tilted, S lying down, flipped S tilted more. So C is a normal S lying on its side (turned 90 degrees), which is option 3. Option 5 also lies on its side but it is the flipped (mirror) S, so it is wrong.
trick: For curved letters like S, check both turning and flipping; a mirror image can look like the right answer.
note: Scan B and D are drawn as mirror (flipped) S shapes at about 60 and 120 degrees; redrawn as flipped S at 45 and 135 degrees so the rule is exact.
